facts.text: Raffles Dubai is an architectural surprise inspired by an Egyptian aesthetic, with sophisticated Asian style.
facts.excerpt: An architectural surprise inspired by an Egyptian aesthetic, 5-star Raffles Dubai offers the luxury of city-centre space, impeccable service and sophisticated Asian style.

facts.text: The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Dubai International Airport.
facts.excerpt: A 15-minute drive from Dubai International Airport

facts.text: The hotel is in the business and shopping district, adjacent to Wafi Mall and close to the Khan Murjan souk and the convention centres.
facts.excerpt: it is ideally located in the business and shopping district, adjacent to Wafi Mall and close to the magnificent Khan Murjan souk and the convention centres.

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by private gardens.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by lush private gardens, Raffles Dubai offers a beautiful breathing space in the city.

facts.text: Rooms have balcony views over the city, with handcrafted decorative items and luxurious fabrics.
facts.excerpt: A rare combination of comfort and contemporary elegance with enchanting balcony views over the city. Handcrafted decorative items and luxurious fabrics create a sophisticated residential ambience.

facts.text: Suites have detailing infused with Middle Eastern and Asian design.
facts.excerpt: Exceptionally spacious with exquisite detailing infused with the essence of Middle Eastern and Asian design

facts.text: Raffles Butlers are available 24/7.
facts.excerpt: Our legendary Raffles Butlers are on hand 24/7

facts.text: Raffles Spa has six spa suites, including one designed for couples.
facts.excerpt: Six luxurious spa suites – including one designed for couples – and more than 1200 sq m of spa and wellness facilities

facts.text: Spa treatments are inspired by Asian, Middle Eastern and European traditions.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a wealth of culturally connected treatments inspired by Asian, Middle Eastern and European traditions

facts.text: The spa facilities include male and female areas, sauna and steam rooms, and a hair salon.
facts.excerpt:
Male & female areas
Sauna & steam rooms
Relaxation areas
Showers
Hair salon

facts.text: The outdoor pool has a heated Jacuzzi, water loungers and a kids pool.
facts.excerpt: Take time out in our 22m outdoor swimming pool with heated Jacuzzi, four water loungers and a kids pool.

facts.text: Solo serves Italian menus inspired by regional recipes from Lombardy, Tuscany, Campania and Sicily.
facts.excerpt: Menus are inspired by much-loved regional recipes, including dishes from Lombardy, Tuscany, Campania and Sicily.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served at Raffles Salon.
facts.excerpt: Afternoon Tea at Raffles Salon

facts.text: A Day With The Chef starts with a personalised tour of the local fish and spice market.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to spend the day in the company of our chef, starting with a personalised tour of the local fish and spice market.

facts.text: The Calligraphy Workshop Stay is a workshop with local calligraphy artist Amir Golshani.
facts.excerpt: In this one-of-a-kind workshop with talented local calligraphy artist Amir Golshani, learn the subtle techniques, nuances and place in Middle Eastern culture of this alphabetic art.

facts.text: The calligraphy package includes an overnight stay in a Diplomatic Suite, a one-hour class in the Penthouse Suite and Treasures of Arabia afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt:
Luxurious overnight stay in a Diplomatic Suite, double occupancy
One-hour class with the calligraphy artist in the Penthouse Suite
Treasures of Arabia afternoon tea

facts.text: The calligraphy workshop requires two weeks' advance booking.
facts.excerpt: Please note: two weeks' advance booking is required

facts.text: The Butler Did It is a bespoke four-night, five-day journey built around Raffles butler service.
facts.excerpt: This bespoke four-night, five-day journey is crafted to your preferences, combining tailored experiences with the legendary service of our Raffles butlers.

facts.text: The hotel has 11 meeting rooms, a library and the Raffles Ballroom.
facts.excerpt: A refreshing approach to meetings, with 11 versatile rooms, library and our stunning Raffles Ballroom

facts.text: Raffles Dubai holds Green Key certification.
facts.excerpt: Awarded with Green Key certification, Raffles Dubai is committed to minimising our impact on the environment

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: 24 Hours \| Hotel Guests

facts.text: The hotel claims the most spacious rooms in the city.
facts.excerpt: Discover the most spacious rooms in the city, sumptuously decorated and blessed with a uniquely Raffles sensibility.

contradictions.note: p5 hours say Solo is closed on Sundays; p5 FAQ says Solo is open daily

sources.excerpt: Solo is open daily, but it's best to check directly for specific hours to plan your visit accordingly.
